ideas.idea: Back up the 'thousands of patients' claim on the home page with concrete evidence (years open, review count, source)
ideas.why: The claim is vague and unsupported in index.njk, and concrete facts help readers and machines understand the practice.

ideas.idea: Show actual prices on the Services page instead of 'Our prices are simple and clear'
ideas.why: services.njk lists no prices despite claiming clarity, so concrete fees would give real, findable information.

ideas.idea: Give each treatment its own page (e.g. /services/implants/)
ideas.why: Services is currently a bare four-item list, and dedicated pages could answer specific cost, process and recovery queries.

ideas.idea: Name the dentists with roles and qualifications on the Team page
ideas.why: team.njk only says 'experienced dentists' with no names, so the page doesn't deliver what it promises.

ideas.idea: Enrich the Dentist JSON-LD with address, openingHours and url, and show opening hours as visible text
ideas.why: The contact JSON-LD has only name and telephone while the address appears only in visible text, and no hours exist anywhere.

ideas.idea: Add Organization or WebSite JSON-LD with name and URL in the base layout
ideas.why: This is standard site-identity markup that fits almost any site and has modest effect here, since a Dentist entity is already planned.

ideas.idea: Add og:title, og:description and og:image social tags
ideas.why: The tags are absent, but this is boilerplate advice for any site and mainly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to the sitemap, possibly generating it with Eleventy
ideas.why: This is accurate for a four-URL hand-kept sitemap, but lastmod has little effect on a site this small.

ideas.idea: Link from Services to Contact with a booking link
ideas.why: The page has no onward link, but the nav already reaches Contact, so the effect on discovery is small.
